exposure.needed: whether any Helm chart rendered by Argo CD (Application Helm sources) has values.yaml files for subcharts containing null object values

consequence.statement: Rendered Kubernetes objects are overridden with the invalid null value from values.yaml null objects, which may require changing subchart values.yaml files.
consequence.remediation: Identify values.yaml files with null object values and remove those null values.

assertion.statement: Upgraded Helm version with breaking changes: Helm was upgraded to 3.17.1

evidence.locator: L221-L232 (v2.14 to 3.0 › Breaking Changes › Upgraded Helm version with breaking changes)
evidence.excerpt:
### Upgraded Helm version with breaking changes

Helm was upgraded to 3.17.1.
This may require changing your `values.yaml` files for subcharts, if the `values.yaml` contain a section with a `null` object.
See related issue in [Helm GitHub repository](https://github.com/helm/helm/issues/12469)
See Helm 3.17.1 [release notes](https://github.com/helm/helm/releases/tag/v3.17.1)
Example of such a [problem and resolution](https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/pull/22035/files)
